dimensions.label: Smallest safe falsification test with interpretable intervention isolation
Calibrated unknowns, provisional quantities, and fallback

anchors.0: Absent, unsafe, contradicted, or materially misleading
anchors.1: Major deficiencies, mostly generic reasoning, or little decision utility
anchors.2: Partially useful but incomplete, generic, or weakly supported
anchors.3: Strong and mostly complete, grounded, and decision-relevant with minor gaps
anchors.4: Complete, workspace-grounded, decision-relevant, and inspectably supported

pairwise_rule: Record explicit blinded preference and ties; never infer preference from scalar score.
